order_wins: **Ratnamani Metals & Tubes** — its subsidiary Ratnamani Finow Spooling Solutions receives **export orders of USD 286 million (about Rs 2,700 crore on the filing's own conversion)** for spools and hangers, over 2-3 years, partly sub-contracted _(~16.4% of mcap)_.

**Ceigall India** — receives a **Rs 704.70 crore Letter of Acceptance** from MoRTH for the Lada-Sarli section of NH-913 in Arunachal Pradesh, in a 74:26 JV with Sushee Infra & Mining _(~12.9% of mcap)_.

**Insolation Energy** — its subsidiary Insolation Green Energy wins MSEDCL letters of award for **99 MW AC (128.7 MW DC) of solar** across nine sites, expected to earn **Rs 59.72 crore a year for 25 years** _(~Rs 425 crore to build, ~20.6% of mcap)_.
**Viviana Power Tech** — confirmed as **L1 bidder for a Rs 275.05 crore** MGVCL network-conversion project across three Gujarat divisions, pending the formal Letter of Intent _(~39.2% of mcap)_.

**GPT Infraprojects** — its subsidiary Alcon Builders is declared **L1 (lowest bidder) for a Rs 97.31 crore** Northeast Frontier Railway electronic-interlocking contract, pending formal award _(~6.8% of mcap)_.
**Brahmaputra Infrastructure** — signs a **Rs 70.18 crore** five-year performance-based maintenance agreement with MoRT&H for 87.18 km of NH-502A in Mizoram _(~14.7% of mcap)_.
**Krystal Integrated Services** — receives a **Rs 17.25 crore, five-year manpower-services work order** from The Maharashtra Rajya Sahakari Sangh, Pune _(~1.9% of mcap)_.

**Gabion Technologies India** — discloses purchase orders received between 9 and 22 August aggregating **Rs 5.24 crore** including taxes, for gabion boxes and slope-protection works, from customers it cannot name under NDAs _(~5.3% of mcap; SME)_.
**Expo Engineering and Projects** — receives a **Rs 4.98 crore** tankage-safety work order from Bharat Petroleum for the Haldia coastal installation, over eight months _(~2.6% of mcap; SME)_.
**Fischer Medical Ventures** — announces that the Catanduanes Integrated Digital Healthcare Project has been awarded to Time Medical Philippines (value not stated in the feed).
**Shelter Pharma** — reports the completion of an export order and the commencement of dispatch (value not stated in the feed).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Aptus Pharma** — board approves a proposed **Rs 44.88 crore preferential issue** of equity shares, subject to members' approval on 14 September, earmarking Rs 25 crore for a manufacturing plant, Rs 10 crore for working capital and Rs 9.88 crore for general corporate purposes.
equity_allotments: **Innomet Advanced Materials** — board approves **11,92,200 fresh convertible warrants at Rs 210 to Mukul Mahavir Agrawal**, aggregating **Rs 25.04 crore** on a preferential basis; proposed, and subject to shareholder approval.
**Minolta Finance** — approves allotment of 40,00,00,000 fully paid-up rights equity shares of Re 1 at Rs 1.20 each, **worth approximately Rs 48.00 crore** (our arithmetic) — new allotment.
**Shanti Gold International** — board outcome recording the allotment of **46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares** of Rs 10 face value (new allotment).
**Genesys International** — allotment of **2,50,74,226 securities** pursuant to its rights issue (new allotment).
**Swojas Foods** — conversion of securities recorded at **Rs 1.98 crore** (past conversion, not new capital).
m_and_a: **Nitco** — signs a non-binding **MOU worth Rs 1,300-1,500 crore** with HOABL Impactum Land to jointly develop its Thal and Lonare land at Alibaug over five years, with definitive agreements pending and only a Rs 9 crore security deposit received _(~56.1% of mcap)_.
**Prozone Realty** — completes the **Rs 1,242.50 crore sale** of its mall subsidiaries (Kruti, Alliance and Empire) to Inorbit Malls, unchanged from the April 2026 announcement _(~195.2% of mcap)_.
**Mitshi India** — Karronn Naresh Bajaj opens an offer to acquire up to 22,88,000 shares (26% of voting capital) at Rs 15 a share, **worth approximately Rs 3.43 crore** (our arithmetic).

**Pavna Industries** — board approves acquiring a 52.38% stake in Pavna Electric Systems (Rs 25.78 crore turnover, a related-party transaction) while divesting its entire stakes in Pavna Auto Engineering and Swapnil Switches, both ceasing to be subsidiaries; no consideration disclosed.

**Almondz Global Securities** — board approves a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge its Infrastructure Advisory business (Rs 2.92 crore turnover, 4.58% of FY26 standalone revenue) into Almondz Global Infra-Consultant, subject to NCLT approval.
**Richfield Financial Services** — Finance Committee approves acquiring a loan portfolio of up to **Rs 7.00 crore** from KLM Axiva Finvest in one or more tranches, at arm's length.
**Indian Hotels / Oriental Hotels** — a Scheme of Arrangement between Oriental Hotels and The Indian Hotels Company is filed with the exchanges by both parties.
**KP Group** — KPI Green Energy, K.P. Energy and KP Green Engineering each file a **non-binding Letter of Intent with Raz Holding Group** for a proposed strategic investment or collaboration.
**Dabur India** — the NCLT New Delhi Bench reserves its order on the second motion petition.
**Tata Consultancy Services** — announces a partnership with **Porsche AG** on AI-powered mobility.
**LEAP India** — incorporates a new step-down subsidiary, LEAP Pallet Pooling Trading L.L.C.
**Gujarat Inject Kerala** — announces that it has entered into a Strategic Business Partnership Agreement.
capex_core: **Aegis Vopak Terminals** — subsidiary Aegis Terminal (Pipavav) **acquires** a 36,000 MT ammonia storage terminal at Pipavav from promoter Aegis Logistics for **Rs 525.00 crore**, a related-party slump sale at arm's length _(~1.7% of mcap)_.
**Fujiyama Power Systems** — enhancement of lithium-battery manufacturing capacity by **1 GWh** at the Ratlam plant, Madhya Pradesh.
**Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers** — announces capacity expansion through **three new facilities**.
business_updates: **Results season** — **19 companies filed** results or earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Smartworks Coworking Spaces** — announces about **Rs 235 crore of incremental contracted rental revenue** driven by enterprise expansions.
**Blue Cloud Softech Solutions** — says it has commenced execution of a **USD 150 million master services agreement** with SpaceX International Ltd, Malaysia.
**IZMO** — business update release carrying a **Rs 65.38 crore** figure.
**Coromandel International** — Dhaksha Unmanned Systems inaugurates a new drone manufacturing facility at Kancheepuram.
**Allied Blenders and Distillers** — launches local production in **Malaysia**.
distress_risk: **Osia Hyper Retail** — intimates the outcome of the fifth Committee of Creditors meeting in its Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.
**Shrenik** — prior intimation of the first Committee of Creditors meeting in its CIRP, alongside a litigation-pendency disclosure.
**SKIL Infrastructure** — pre-facto intimation of the tenth Committee of Creditors meeting, to be held on 25 August.
**Kirloskar Brothers** — files the order passed by the Supreme Court of India dated 11 August.
**Indian Railway Finance Corporation** — discloses the pendency of litigation whose outcome could affect the company.
**Raghuvir Synthetics** — receives a GST show-cause notice under Section 74/74A of the CGST and Gujarat GST Acts.
other_notable: **TCC Concept** — fixes **4 September 2026** as the record date for its split/subdivision.
**Vivo Bio Tech** — reports the **expiry of the convertible warrants allotted on 24 February 2025**; that capital does not arrive.
